scope: Actual independent CP2K orthorhombic periodic Gamma UKS H3; integer Na2 Nb1; one 80Ry grid; four PBE models; no native qualification implied
stress_convention: CP2K own NUMERICAL full-SCF compressive-positive tensor [bar] converted to GPa; native scope restricted xx/yy/zz; 20 converged SCF expected per case

command:
module load CP2K/2026.2-gcc-2026.03-mpich-eb
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
cd "$1"
shift
python3 -c 'import json,os,socket;print(json.dumps({"hostname":socket.gethostname(),"environment":{k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ["OMP_NUM_THREADS","OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS","SLURM_JOB_ID","SLURM_STEP_ID","SLURM_JOB_NODELIST"]}},indent=2))' > execution.json
